== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Watchmen]] are a group associated with the [[Blackwatch]], an organization identified by the crest of Elder Eyes. It is believed that their objective is to produce a succession of replaceable [[Emperors]], replacing any ruler who becomes corrupted by the influence of the [[Elders]]. One specific Watchman is noted for betraying his [[Guild]]; this individual possessed sensitive knowledge regarding the Emperor's longevity, the location of [[Nakothi]]'s death, and the existence of eleven other hearts belonging to the [[Dead Mother]]. This disgraced Watchman and his crew were involved in an attempt to harvest a heart from [[Nakothi]]'s remains on an island to achieve immortality. Additionally, [[Watchmen]] have been known to be unable to bypass certain cordons or magical barriers that isolate specific locations from the rest of the world.}}
